C1085.title: Man Recruits Users for Gambling Software to Profit
C1085.summary: Around 2020, the defendant Zhang met Zhong in a WeChat group, downloaded gambling software, and became a downstream agent. To profit, Zhang recruited individuals like Hu and Wu to download the software using his invitation code, building a downstream network. The cumulative recharge amount reached over 1.789 million yuan, with Zhang illegally profiting approximately 7,000 yuan. The court convicted
